division.heading: Lawyers’ Charges, Retainer Agreements and Right of Review

operative_text.controlling:
10.6(1)  In a retainer agreement or otherwise, a provision is void if
the provision
(a) purports to relieve a lawyer from liability for negligence
or any other liability to which the lawyer might be subject
as a lawyer, or
(b) purports to provide that an action, application or
proceeding cannot be abandoned, discontinued or settled
without a lawyer’s consent.
(2)  Despite any agreement to the contrary, a client may change the
client’s lawyer or act on the client’s own behalf before a retainer
agreement ends.
